assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Regular hexagon MCNATS with N at the top and S at the bottom; the original sides CN and NA and the diagonal CA are dashed grey. The concave hexagon M C N' A T S is drawn solid, with N' at the centre of the hexagon. A red circle with centre P on segment SN' passes through N' and touches sides ST and SM; dashed blue radii go from P to N' and to the two points of tangency.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
